<style>

panels.title: ◉ Estimated Yield (%)

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting
) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL), 0)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
),
prev_val AS (
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting
) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL), 0)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Estimated Yield: percentage of samples where max|PE| <= pe_setting (within tolerance).

panels.title: ◉ Fleet Availability (%)

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM latest
),
prev_val AS (
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM latest
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Percent of selected machines whose latest state in the selected time range is true.

panels.title: ◉ Avg Cpk (Fleet)

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS sigma, AVG(pe_setting) AS lim
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), cpk AS (
  SELECT LEAST((lim - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0), (mean_pe + lim) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0)) AS value FROM stats
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value FROM cpk
),
prev_val AS (
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS sigma, AVG(pe_setting) AS lim
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), cpk AS (
  SELECT LEAST((lim - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0), (mean_pe + lim) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0)) AS value FROM stats
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value FROM cpk
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Average real Cpk across machines with PE data in the selected filters. Assumes symmetric +/- pe_setting limits.

panels.title: ◉ Critical Alarms
panels.description: Counts real alarm rows for selected machine IDs that match a Critical master code. Zero is valid because current log codes do not match the supplied master.

panels.title: ◉ Worst Cpk (Fleet, 24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(worst_cpk)::NUMERIC, 3) AS value FROM public.v_machine_spc_fleet WHERE worst_cpk IS NOT NULL;

panels.description: Worst Cpk across the entire registered LDI fleet in the trailing 24h, where Worst Cpk per machine = LEAST(Cpk PE, Cpk JE). Always reflects all enabled machines regardless of the Factory/MO/Machine filters above — this is a fleet-wide floor, not a filtered view. Backed by v_machine_spc_fleet (migration 042).

panels.title: ◉ JE Pass Rate (Fleet, 24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * SUM(n_je * je_pass_rate / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(n_je), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.v_machine_spc_fleet;

panels.description: Fleet-wide JE pass rate over the trailing 24h: percent of individual je_1..je_4 samples within +/- je_setting, weighted by sample count across all machines (not an average of per-machine percentages). Backed by v_machine_spc_fleet (migration 042).

panels.title: ◉ Machine Count (Fleet)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(n_pe, 0) + COALESCE(n_je, 0) > 0))::TEXT || ' / ' || COUNT(*)::TEXT AS value FROM public.v_machine_spc_fleet;

panels.description: Reporting / Total registered+enabled LDI machines (public.devices, device_type='ldi'). "Reporting" = at least one PE or JE sample in the trailing 24h. The denominator is always the full fleet, so a machine that goes silent shows up as a gap here instead of disappearing from the dashboard. Backed by v_machine_spc_fleet (migration 042).

panels.title: ◉ Running

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true)::NUMERIC AS value FROM latest
),
prev_val AS (
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true)::NUMERIC AS value FROM latest
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Count of machines with state=true (powered on and available). Red < 8, Green >= 8 of 10.

panels.title: ◈ PE Limit Used

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_rows AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      ABS(pe_1), ABS(pe_2), ABS(pe_3),
      ABS(pe_4), ABS(pe_5), ABS(pe_6)
    ) AS max_error,
    pe_setting
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
    AND pe_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND pe_setting > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(100.0 * max_error / pe_setting)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM pe_rows

panels.description: Average MAX|PE| divided by the PE limit stored on each record. This normalized scale allows machines with different PE limits to be compared fairly.

panels.title: ◉ Avg Temperature

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (
SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND temperature IS NOT NULL
),
prev_val AS (
SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND temperature IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Fleet-wide average temperature. Target 22±2°C. Red outside 20-24°C, Amber 20-24°C, Green 22-24°C.

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (

prev_val AS (
SELECT ROUND(AVG(humidity)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND humidity IS NOT NULL
)

panels.description: Fleet-wide average humidity. Target 55±5%RH. Red outside 50-60%, Amber 50-60%, Green 55-60%.

panels.title: ◈ Production & Process Table

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id AS "Machine", mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Progress", ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "temperature (°C)", ROUND(humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "humidity (%RH)", ROUND(scan_speed::NUMERIC, 1) AS "scan_speed (mm/s)", ROUND(thickness::NUMERIC, 3) AS "thickness (mm)", ROUND(resist_dosage::NUMERIC, 1) AS "resist_dosage", state AS "state" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY eqp_id, time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Latest production context per machine: job info + live physical parameters (temperature, humidity, scan_speed, thickness, resist_dosage, state).

panels.title: ◈ temperature Compliance (22±2°C)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, eqp_id AS metric, CASE WHEN temperature BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN 2 WHEN temperature BETWEEN 19 AND 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND temperature IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: 3-color compliance matrix per machine. Green 20-24°C, Amber 19-25°C, Red outside.

panels.title: ◈ humidity Compliance (55±5%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, eqp_id AS metric, CASE WHEN humidity BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN 2 WHEN humidity BETWEEN 45 AND 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: 3-color compliance matrix per machine. Green 50-60%, Amber 45-65%, Red outside.

panels.title: ◈ Scan Speed & Air Vacuum

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time, eqp_id || ' - scan_speed' AS metric, AVG(avg_scan_speed) AS value FROM public.ldi_data_1m WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_scan_speed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time, eqp_id || ' - air_vacuum' AS metric, AVG(avg_air_vacuum) AS value FROM public.ldi_data_1m WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_air_vacuum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Dual Y-axis: scan_speed (left, mm/s) and air_vacuum (right, kPa) per machine.

panels.title: ◈ Thickness & Resist Dosage

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time, eqp_id || ' - thickness' AS metric, AVG(avg_thickness) AS value FROM public.ldi_data_1m WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_thickness IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time, eqp_id || ' - resist_dosage' AS metric, AVG(avg_resist_dosage) AS value FROM public.ldi_data_1m WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_resist_dosage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Dual Y-axis: thickness (left, mm) and resist_dosage (right, mJ/cm²) per machine.

panels.title: ◈ Scale X / Y

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time, eqp_id || ' - scale_x' AS metric, AVG(avg_scale_x) AS value FROM public.ldi_data_1m WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_scale_x IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time, eqp_id || ' - scale_y' AS metric, AVG(avg_scale_y) AS value FROM public.ldi_data_1m WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_scale_y IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: XY calibration drift. High-precision (6 decimals) monitoring of scale_x and scale_y ratios. Drift from 1.0 indicates lens magnification error.

panels.title: ◈ Calculated Time per Board

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS "time", eqp_id AS metric,
       ROUND(AVG(total_time / NULLIF(total_board, 0))::NUMERIC,2) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND total_board > 0
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Calculated value from total_time divided by total_board. Confirm the source definition of total_time before treating this as authoritative cycle time.

panels.title: ◈ Z-Score: temperature

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(temperature) AS mu, STDDEV_SAMP(temperature) AS sigma
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND temperature IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eqp_id
)
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', d."time") AS "time", d.eqp_id AS metric, ROUND(AVG((d.temperature-s.mu)/NULLIF(s.sigma, 0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Z-Score"
FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN stats s ON d.eqp_id=s.eqp_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  AND d.temperature IS NOT NULL AND s.sigma > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.description: 3-sigma Z-Score on temperature per machine. Green ±2 (normal), Amber 2.5 (watch), Red 3+ (anomaly).

panels.title: ◈ Latest Alarm Records (Historical)
panels.description: Latest real alarm rows for selected machine IDs, independent of telemetry time because the exports cover different dates.

panels.title: ◉ Top Correlated Alarms (24h)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: query defines its own rolling 24h window */
WITH alarm_ctx AS (
  SELECT c.*, cat.category
  FROM v_ldi_alarm_context c
  JOIN v_ldi_alarm_category cat ON cat.alarm_code = c.errorcode WHERE c.alarm_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature < 20 OR temperature > 24) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS thermal_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE humidity < 50 OR humidity > 60) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS humidity_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE air_vacuum > -50 OR air_vacuum < -95) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS vac_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(pe_1) > 10 OR ABS(je_1) > 10) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS pe_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE scan_speed > 450 OR scan_speed <= 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS motion_pct
  FROM public.ldi_data WHERE "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
),
cats AS (
  SELECT 'THERMAL (91008)' AS cat, ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_thermal_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS alarm_pct, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'ENVIRONMENT'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HUMIDITY (91008)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_humidity_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'ENVIRONMENT'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'VACUUM (91009)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_vac_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'VACUUM'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALIGNMENT/PE-JE (90001,90004,90005,90012,90013)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_pe_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category IN ('REGISTRATION','ALIGNMENT')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MOTION (70004)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_scan_speed_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE category = 'MOTION'
)
SELECT c.cat AS "Alarm Category",
       c.alarm_pct AS "Alarm-Window %",
       CASE
         WHEN c.cat = 'THERMAL (91008)' THEN b.thermal_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'HUMIDITY (91008)' THEN b.humidity_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'VACUUM (91009)' THEN b.vac_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'MOTION (70004)' THEN b.motion_pct
         ELSE b.pe_pct
       END AS "Baseline %",
       ROUND((c.alarm_pct / NULLIF(CASE
         WHEN c.cat = 'THERMAL (91008)' THEN b.thermal_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'HUMIDITY (91008)' THEN b.humidity_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'VACUUM (91009)' THEN b.vac_pct
         WHEN c.cat = 'MOTION (70004)' THEN b.motion_pct
         ELSE b.pe_pct
       END, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Lift",
       c.n AS "Event Count",
       CASE WHEN c.n < 30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM cats c CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY "Lift" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Fleet-wide RCA lift summary, rolling 24h, using v_ldi_alarm_category (migration 036) and the extended v_ldi_alarm_context flags (migration 045: split thermal/humidity, added MOTION). Same lift methodology as Engineering Analytics. EXPOSURE not shown (no matching alarm code exists yet). MOTION reads 0% on current mock data (scan_speed is constant per machine, no real overspeed events).

title: IMS LDI - Manufacturing Command Center
